'''Scott Lingrell''' ([[GEMP]] '''[[Advocate|advocate]]'''; also '''crngwell''') is the current '''Lead Advocate''' (Head Advocate) of the [[Players Committee]]. The PC is an organization of [[Advocate|Advocates]]; his GEMP handle is that same word, '''advocate'''. On the ~August 2005 swccgpc.com Advocate Council page he is listed as '''Card Design Advocate'''. Later public PC organization charts list him as '''Lead Advocate''' with handle '''advocate'''.<ref name="council2005">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050829220138/http://www.swccgpc.com/council.htm Advocate Council], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 29 August 2005)</ref><ref name="orgchart2021">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 8 July 2021; [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005193353/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Wayback 5 October 2021]</ref><ref name="orgchart2024">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 6 May 2024; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf live orgchart.pdf]</ref>

He also goes by '''crngwell'''. SWCCG videos are on YouTube at [https://www.youtube.com/@crngwell @crngwell].<ref name="yt">[https://www.youtube.com/@crngwell @crngwell] on YouTube ([https://www.youtube.com/@crngwell/videos videos])</ref>

This page is a '''fan encyclopedia''' stub. It does '''not''' invent biography beyond the cited roster lines.

== Handles ==

* '''advocate''' — [[GEMP]] handle. Same string as the PC forum / organization-chart handle. He is the current Head / Lead [[Advocate]].<ref name="orgchart2021" /><ref name="orgchart2024" />
* '''crngwell''' (written '''CRingwell''' on the ~August 2008 Advocate Council list) — additional handle; YouTube channel [https://www.youtube.com/@crngwell @crngwell].<ref name="yt" /><ref name="enc2008vol">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080831140913/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Encyclopedia Encyclopedia], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 31 August 2008)</ref>

== Documented PC roles ==

* '''~August 2005:''' Card Design Advocate on council.htm.<ref name="council2005" />
* '''Org chart 2021 (PDF CreationDate 8 July 2021; IA 5 October 2021):''' Lead Advocate; handle '''advocate'''.<ref name="orgchart2021" />
* '''Org chart 2024 (PDF CreationDate 6 May 2024):''' Lead Advocate; handle '''advocate''' (still listed).<ref name="orgchart2024" />

The ~October 2014 starwarsccg.org About "Current Advocates" block labels the Lead slot only '''Advocate''' (placeholder) without printing this legal name; the org-chart identity above is a later, separately dated source.<ref name="swcabout2014">[https://web.archive.org/web/20141009180158/http://www.starwarsccg.org/about/ About], starwarsccg.org (Wayback, 9 October 2014)</ref><ref name="orgchart2021" /><ref name="orgchart2024" />

He finished '''#34''' at both the [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]] and the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (lost Round of 64; Challonge seed 31).
